userStories.title: Hub Auto-Refresh Every 30 Seconds
userStories.description: Hub data refreshes automatically so long-running sessions stay current without requiring a manual reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Pending reviews and recent runs refetch every 30 seconds
Subtle 'Updated just now' timestamp in section footer
No full-page reload — only data refetch
SSE drives active run card (not polling)
Auto-refresh pauses when tab is backgrounded (visibilitychange API)

userStories.title: Run View Metadata Panel
userStories.description: Below the story list pane, a metadata section shows detailed run information including token usage, timing, and branch context.
acceptanceCriteria: Tokens: input count / output count formatted with K suffix
Estimated time remaining (based on average story duration so far)
Git branch name with copy button
Worktree path if applicable
PID display with kill link
Model used badge
Cost: '$0.00 (your Claude sub)' for claude --print mode

userStories.title: Run View Semantic Log View
userStories.description: A structured view of terminal output grouped by agent action type, shown as a toggle alternative to the raw terminal. Parse xterm output for [Read]/[Write]/[Planning]/[Executing]/[Commit] prefixes and render grouped collapsible sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse xterm output for known prefixes: Read:, Write:, Bash:, Task:, Planning, Committing
Group consecutive same-type actions into collapsible sections
Section headers: [Read] [Write] [Executing] [Planning] [Committing]
Each section shows action count badge when collapsed
Default view is raw terminal; toggle button switches to semantic view
Semantic view updates in real time as terminal receives new data
Unknown output lines shown in [Output] group

userStories.title: Forge Template Selector
userStories.description: Users can start from a saved template instead of a blank brief in the Forge screen.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Start from template →' link opens a modal
Modal shows template cards: name, description, story count, last used date
Search/filter bar in modal
Select template: populates brief with template description, sets story count
'Blank slate' option always at top of list
Empty state when no templates saved: 'No templates yet — generate a spec and save it as a template'

userStories.title: Spec Review Filter Bar
userStories.description: Filter and search stories within a spec review screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input filters by story title or description (case-insensitive)
Status filter chips: All / Excluded / Has Dependencies
Complexity filter: All / Low / Medium / High
Filter state shown as active chip count badge
Clear all filters button
Filter persists while on this screen, resets on navigation

userStories.title: Spec Review Dependency Visualization
userStories.description: Show which stories depend on which in the spec review screen.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Depends on: V2-001, V2-002' shown below each story card
Clicking dependency badge scrolls to and highlights that story
Stories with no dependsOn show 'No dependencies'
Circular dependency warning shown in red if detected
'Dependency chain' button opens a mini DAG modal for the whole spec

userStories.title: Settings Account and Billing Tab
userStories.description: Full Stripe billing information and subscription management in the Settings Account/Billing tab.
acceptanceCriteria: Billing tab: current plan badge (Free / Solo / Pro / Team)
Active subscription details: plan name, renewal date, seats used
Upgrade CTA with plan comparison table
Manage billing link opens Stripe customer portal
Invoice history: list of past invoices with download link
Cancel subscription flow with confirmation and grace period explanation

userStories.title: Micro-Animation Story Completion
userStories.description: A subtle animation when a story passes in the Run View story list.
acceptanceCriteria: Row background flashes green for 600ms when status changes to pass
Checkmark icon animates in with a scale(0→1) + opacity transition
No layout shift during animation
Animation uses CSS keyframes (no JS animation library required)
Animation does not replay on re-render — only on status change event

userStories.title: Micro-Animation Run Start and Completion
userStories.description: Animations marking run lifecycle events in the Hub and top bar.
acceptanceCriteria: Run pill in top bar: dot fades in with pulse animation on run start
Hub active run card: slides down into Running section on run start
On run completion: card transitions from blue to green or red border over 1s
Completion toast shows with slide-in from top-right
Hub run card moves to Recent Runs list with smooth slide animation

userStories.title: Micro-Animation Graph Node Completion Ripple
userStories.description: Graph nodes animate when their status changes in the Run View graph tab.
acceptanceCriteria: Node status change triggers a ripple ring animation (expand and fade)
Blue → green transition for pass (300ms ease-out)
Ripple color matches new status
Running node has continuous pulse (CSS animation, not JS)
No animation for bulk state restore (e.g., page load populating existing run data)

userStories.title: Loading Skeleton Screens
userStories.description: Skeleton placeholder screens shown while data loads to prevent blank flashes.
acceptanceCriteria: Hub shows skeleton: 3 grey card shapes while fetching
Run View shows skeleton terminal lines (10 grey bars) while connecting
Forge shows skeleton for direction stack sidebar while fetching
Skeletons match layout of real content exactly
Transition from skeleton to content is instant (no flash)
Skeletons use Tailwind animate-pulse

userStories.title: Error State Run Failed
userStories.description: Prominent error display when a run ends in failure, shown in both Hub and Run View.
acceptanceCriteria: Hub run card switches to red border with ✗ Failed badge
Run View shows red banner: 'Run failed — N stories did not complete'
Failed stories highlighted red in story list
'Retry failed stories' button triggers selective retry API
'View error detail' expands terminal to last failed story's output
WAL run_finished event with status=failed drives this state

userStories.title: Error State Story Failed with Retry
userStories.description: Individual story failure handling in the Run View story list.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed story row shows ✗ icon, red background, retry count badge
Expand row: shows last 20 lines of story output
'Retry this story' button calls POST /api/pipeline/runs/:id/retry
Retry resets story status to running in UI immediately
Max retries (3) shown as '2/3 retries used'
Story failure writes WAL story_failed event

userStories.title: Mobile Responsive Hub and Navigation
userStories.description: Hub and navigation adapt for screens smaller than 768px.
acceptanceCriteria: Left nav collapses on mobile — hamburger in top bar opens slide-in drawer
Hub pending review cards stack to 1 column
Hub active run card full width
Top bar workspace switcher truncates to first word
Touch targets minimum 44×44px on all buttons
No horizontal scroll on any screen at 375px viewport

userStories.title: Mobile Responsive Run View
userStories.description: Run View adapts for mobile with a stacked layout instead of side-by-side split pane.
acceptanceCriteria: Split pane switches to vertical stack on < 768px
Terminal on top (60vh), story list below (scroll)
Bottom tabs become scrollable horizontal strip
Graph tab hides on mobile (too complex for small screens) with explanation message
Keyboard shortcuts disabled on mobile (no hardware keyboard assumed)
Touch scroll works in both terminal and story list panes

userStories.title: ARIA Labels and Semantic HTML Throughout
userStories.description: All interactive elements have proper ARIA labels for screen reader compatibility across Hub, Run View, Forge, and Settings.
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons have aria-label when no visible text
All icon-only buttons labeled: 'Pause run', 'Kill run', 'Open command palette'
Nav items have aria-current='page' when active
Progress bars use role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max
Status badges use aria-live='polite' for live updates
Form inputs have associated labels (not placeholder-only)
axe-core scan reports zero critical violations on Hub and Run View

userStories.title: Keyboard Focus Management
userStories.description: Proper focus management for modals, command palette, and navigation throughout the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Command palette traps focus inside while open
Modal dialogs trap focus inside while open
Focus returns to trigger element when palette/modal closes
Visible focus ring on all focusable elements (not removed by outline:none)
Tab order matches visual order on all screens
Skip-to-content link at top of page for keyboard users

userStories.title: Virtual Scroll for Large Story Lists
userStories.description: Story list in Run View uses virtual scroll to handle 100+ story specs without performance degradation.
acceptanceCriteria: React virtual or TanStack Virtual renders only visible rows
Smooth scroll with no jank for 100+ story spec
Row height fixed at 48px (no dynamic height required)
Scroll position preserved on tab switch
Selected/active story scrolled into view automatically
Virtual scroll works with keyboard navigation (arrow keys)

userStories.title: Code Splitting and Route-Based Lazy Loading
userStories.description: Each major screen is code-split so initial bundle is small.
acceptanceCriteria: Hub, RunView, Forge, Settings each in separate lazy-loaded chunk
React.lazy + Suspense wraps each route
Loading fallback is the skeleton screen (not a spinner)
Initial JS bundle < 200kb gzipped
Vite build confirms no single chunk > 500kb
Lighthouse performance score > 90 on Hub screen

userStories.title: First Paint Under 2 Seconds
userStories.description: App renders meaningful content within 2 seconds on a fast 3G connection.
acceptanceCriteria: LCP < 2.5s on simulated fast 3G in Lighthouse
FCP < 1.5s
CLS < 0.1 (no layout shift from skeleton transitions)
Top bar and left nav render before data loads
No render-blocking scripts
Images (if any) have explicit width/height or aspect-ratio

userStories.title: Hub Ready-to-Run Queue
userStories.description: Add a 'Ready to Run' section to HubPanel.tsx between Pending Reviews and Recent Runs, showing approved specs that have not yet been triggered. Users can trigger a run directly from the Hub without navigating to the Archive panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Hub shows a 'Ready to Run' section between Pending Reviews and Recent Runs
Fetch approved specs from GET /api/specs?status=approved and filter out any that have an active or recent run (cross-reference pipeline_runs)
Each card shows: spec title, story count badge, 'Generated N days ago' timestamp, workspace badge
Each card has a 'Trigger →' button that calls POST /api/pipeline/trigger with the spec path and workspace ID
On trigger: button shows spinner, card moves to the Active Run section when run_started WAL event arrives via SSE
Empty state: 'No specs ready to run — approve a spec in Forge to get started' with a link to Forge
Section hidden entirely when empty (no empty section header taking up space)
Cards respect the auto-refresh cadence from P2-001 (refetch every 30s)
Conflict detection: if a run is already active for that workspace, Trigger button shows 'Workspace busy' and is disabled
Trigger button tooltip shows the full spec path for power users
